prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Settings now shows credit history with localized dates, actions, amounts, and refund labels in English and Korean. TypeScript passed; lint reported only existing warnings.

@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import CreditTransaction, WorkspaceMember
+from app.services.billing import billing_service
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def test_history_lists_charges_refunds_and_refills_for_workspace_members(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    member = signup(client, email="member@example.com")
+    workspace_id = UUID(client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner).json()[0]["id"])
+    member_workspace = UUID(client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=member).json()[0]["id"])
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        owner_id = session.exec(select(WorkspaceMember.user_id).where(WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == workspace_id)).first()
+        member_id = session.exec(select(WorkspaceMember.user_id).where(WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == member_workspace)).first()
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=workspace_id, user_id=member_id, role="member"))
+        session.commit()
+        charge = billing_service.deduct_credits(session, workspace_id, owner_id, "generate_project_cover_image")
+        billing_service.refund_credits(session, charge)
+        billing_service.deduct_credits(session, workspace_id, member_id, "augment_worldview")
+        billing_service.check_daily_refill(session, workspace_id)
+        billing_service.deduct_credits(session, member_workspace, member_id, "recommend_style")
+        rows = session.exec(select(CreditTransaction).where(CreditTransaction.workspace_id == workspace_id)).all()
+        # Give each entry a distinct timestamp, independent of database clock precision.
+        timestamps = {
+            "refunded:generate_project_cover_image": 0,
+            "refund:generate_project_cover_image": 1,
+            "augment_worldview": 2,
+            "daily_refill": 3,
+        }
+        for row in rows:
+            row.timestamp = datetime(2025, 1, 1) + timedelta(seconds=timestamps[row.action_type])
+            session.add(row)
+        session.commit()
+    path = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/credits/history"
+    for headers in (owner, member):
+        response = client.get(path, headers=headers)
+        assert response.status_code == 200
+        assert response.json() == [
+            {"amount": 50, "action": "daily_refill", "created_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:03"},
+            {"amount": -5, "action": "augment_worldview", "created_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:02"},
+            {"amount": 15, "action": "refund:generate_project_cover_image", "created_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:01"},
+            {"amount": -15, "action": "generate_project_cover_image", "created_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00"},
+        ]
+
+
+def test_history_hides_other_and_nonexistent_workspaces(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    outsider = signup(client, email="outsider@example.com")
+    workspace_id = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner).json()[0]["id"]
+    path = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/credits/history"
+    assert client.get(path, headers=owner).json() == []
+    denied = client.get(path, headers=outsider)
+    missing = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{uuid4()}/credits/history", headers=outsider)
+    assert denied.status_code == missing.status_code == 404
+    assert denied.json() == missing.json()
+    assert client.get(path).status_code == 401

+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import pytest
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models.models import Workspace, Project, Character, CreditTransaction
+from app.services.billing import billing_service
+from app.tasks.project_tasks import generate_project_cover_task
+from app.tasks.character_tasks import generate_character_image_task
+
+
+def setup_objects():
+    user_id = uuid4()
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        ws = Workspace(name="studio", owner_id=user_id)
+        session.add(ws)
+        session.commit()
+        project = Project(title="story", workspace_id=ws.id, owner_id=user_id, style_preset="ink")
+        session.add(project)
+        session.commit()
+        character = Character(project_id=project.id, name="hero", consistency_seed=1)
+        session.add(character)
+        session.commit()
+        return user_id, ws.id, project.id, character.id
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["cover", "character"])
+def test_background_failure_refunds_original_charge(client, monkeypatch, kind):
+    user, workspace, project, character = setup_objects()
+    action = "generate_project_cover_image" if kind == "cover" else "generate_character_sheet"
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        charge = billing_service.deduct_credits(session, workspace, user, action)
+    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("generation failed")
+    from app.services.ai import ai_service
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, action, fail)
+    if kind == "cover":
+        generate_project_cover_task(str(project), "story", "fantasy", "", "ink", charge_id=charge)
+    else:
+        generate_character_image_task(character, "", charge_id=charge)
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace).credits == 500
+        assert (session.get(Project, project).cover_image_status if kind == "cover" else session.get(Character, character).sheet_status) == "failed"
+        billing_service.refund_credits(session, charge)
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace).credits == 500
+        transactions = session.exec(select(CreditTransaction).where(CreditTransaction.workspace_id == workspace)).all()
+        assert sorted(t.amount for t in transactions) == ([-15, 15] if kind == "cover" else [-20, 20])
+
+
+def test_sync_failure_refunds_and_success_remains_charged(client):
+    user, workspace, _, _ = setup_objects()
+    @billing_service.refund_on_failure
+    def work(session, fail):
+        billing_service.deduct_credits(session, workspace, user, "augment_worldview")
+        if fail:
+            raise RuntimeError("generation failed")
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+            work(session, True)
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace).credits == 500
+        work(session, False)
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace).credits == 495
+
+
+def test_worldview_request_refunds_ai_failure(client, monkeypatch):
+    from tests.conftest import signup
+    from app.services.ai import ai_service
+    headers = signup(client)
+    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("generation failed")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, "augment_worldview", fail)
+    response = client.post("/api/v1/projects/worldview/augment", headers=headers,
+                           json={"description": "A city", "title": "Story", "genres": []})
+    assert response.status_code == 500
+    assert client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()[0]["credits"] == 500
+
+
+def test_successful_background_generation_keeps_charge(client, monkeypatch):
+    user, workspace, project, _ = setup_objects()
+    from app.services.ai import ai_service
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, "generate_project_cover_image", lambda *args, **kwargs: b"image")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "upload_image", lambda *args, **kwargs: "https://example.test/cover.png")
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        charge = billing_service.deduct_credits(session, workspace, user, "generate_project_cover_image")
+    generate_project_cover_task(str(project), "story", "fantasy", "", "ink", charge_id=charge)
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace).credits == 485
+        assert session.get(Project, project).cover_image_status == "completed"
